The mains supply feeds the HAT's USB-C input, not the Pi's — which is what lets the device be unplugged mid-conversation and keep running.
Measured under sustained inference: 16–19 W, peaks past 21 W, 48–53 °C idle with the cooler fitted, and a clean 5 V rail on battery (throttled=0x0).
Not shown because it is not fitted in this build: the RTC battery on the BAT header, needed for timekeeping once the device is genuinely offline.
